analysis:
Examined all supplied source, patches and metadata against the canonical index and selected details. ProviderLoop+AutoUpdate.swift:157 changes only quarantine logging; AutoUpdateController.swift:127 changes only a comment. Their surrounding drain, cancellation, worker-retirement and restart sequencing is unchanged. SelfUpdater.swift:65 broadens the clock closure from private to internal for the new extension, without exposing mutable state or a public control.
SelfUpdater+Rollback.swift adds operator rollback of pending or promoted releases. Lines 60–69 acquire a nonblocking update lease and recover; 75–104 require a recorded live install, an older predecessor, predecessor verification and a nonoverflowing generation. Lines 110–120 recover and revalidate version/generation after confirmation before invoking journaled rollback. These visible checks support T-013/T-034/T-043 protections; no concrete bypass or regression is established here. No changed prompt, key, encryption, cache, media, billing or privileged-helper handling is visible.
Integration must verify the new API's material external contracts: UpdateSession.rollback/recover and UpdateRecoveryState.rollbackSource must preserve verified artifacts and crash-consistent layout, including the error-recovery success test at SelfUpdater+Rollback.swift:124–127. CLI/lifecycle callers must hold the lease, drain accepted work and terminal delivery, retire the App Attest worker, and restart safely. Check that rollback/quarantine of a promoted release does not confer serving qualification or bypass current revocations (A-017, T-053/T-054), and reconcile this expanded operator path with T-043. Those implementations and callers are not supplied; their absence is a coverage limit, not evidence of missing controls. No independently supported finding in this source batch.
